messages.subject: Wrapping up your projects this summer
messages.subject_clean: Wrapping up your projects this summer
messages.body_plain:
This is a friendly administrative reminder that we have a little under
two weeks left before Google's 'soft pencils down' date of September
16th and a little over three weeks left before Google's 'hard pencils
down' date of September 23rd.

Students:
Make sure your work passes 'R CMD build' and 'R CMD check'.  Please also
make sure that your documentation, tests, examples, and vignettes do
what you want them to do.  Tie up any loose ends in your code. Make sure
all your code is in a *public* repository, even if you've been doing
work in a 'private' repo up to this point.  Google requires code in a
public repository to consider the project a success.

Mentors:
Please help your students wrap things up.  If this means final scope
changes/decreases, please make them now.  No one benefits from a
headlong rush to the finish line if you're not left with something
useful at the end.

All:
If you have questions or need help with something, please feel free to
contact me and/or any of the other R GSoC org. admins (Toby, Virgilio,
John) off-list.

Regards,

Brian

--
Brian G. Peterson
http://braverock.com/brian/

IM: bgpbraverock

messages.subject: results on Rwiki
messages.body_plain:
Mentors and students, thanks for your efforts in GSOC 2013!

As in previous years we would like a summary of results on the R wiki for future reference.

http://rwiki.sciviews.org/doku.php?id=developers:projects:gsoc2013

Please fill in the Results column with

1. a link to where we can find the code, and

2. a description of remaining work that could be done in next year's GSOC.
